answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in a public trust graph, and require every new edge to be backed by a bond the voucher forfeits if the newcomer is caught cheating. A sybil farm must then post a fresh bond per fake identity, and its clones tend to mirror each other in timing and output, which an open atlas of interaction patterns makes easy to flag. One detected clone burns every voucher bond in its cluster, so attack cost grows linearly while payoff does not.
